short: A pioneering British aircraft carrier, HMS Ark Royal played crucial roles in the hunting of the Bismarck and the Mediterranean naval war.
full:
Commissioned in 1938, HMS Ark Royal was the first purpose-built aircraft carrier of the Royal Navy designed with the flight deck integrated into the hull. She was heavily involved in the early years of the war, participating in the Norwegian campaign and Force H operations in the Mediterranean. Her Swordfish torpedo bombers scored the critical hit that crippled the Bismarck's steering gear in May 1941.

Ark Royal gained a reputation as a lucky ship after surviving multiple German claims of her sinking. Her luck ran out in November 1941 when she was torpedoed by the German submarine U-81 near Gibraltar. Despite a prolonged effort to tow her to safety, she sank the following day, taking only one crewman with her.
